research_question: Do futures-index dislocations become tradable only after a separate confirmation bar distinguishes reflexive overshoot repair from spot-confirmed price discovery?

scenario.context: five-minute futures-index basis and relative-return shock under abnormal futures volume
scenario.interaction: perpetual price departs materially from Binance composite index price

state_router.REFLEXIVE_BASIS_REPAIR: basis compresses and the index does not follow during the next completed bar; trade reversal
state_router.INDEX_CONFIRMED_DISCOVERY: index follows, cross-market breadth agrees and basis does not repair during the next completed bar; trade continuation

scenario.invalidation_target_note: This is a mechanism screen only; surviving routes must be frozen with event-extreme invalidation and causal index/basis objectives inside NautilusTrader.

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M futures klines plus indexPriceKlines

evaluation.overlap_policy: no entry while the selected route horizon is active
